		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		[BPF_JMP | BPF_TAIL_CALL] = &&JMP_TAIL_CALL,
		[BPF_ST  | BPF_NOSPEC] = &&ST_NOSPEC,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_B] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_B,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_H] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_H,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_W] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_W,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_DW] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_DW,
	};
#undef BPF_INSN_3_LBL
#undef BPF_INSN_2_LBL
	u32 tail_call_cnt = 0;

#define CONT	 ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })
#define CONT_JMP ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })

select_insn:
	goto *jumptable[insn->code];

	/* Explicitly mask the register-based shift amounts with 63 or 31
	 */
	/* ALU (shifts) */
		CONT;
	/* ALU (rest) */
		CONT;
	ALU(ADD,  +)
	ALU(SUB,  -)
	ALU(AND,  &)
	ALU(OR,   |)
	ALU(XOR,  ^)
	ALU(MUL,  *)
	SHT(LSH, <<)
	SHT(RSH, >>)
#undef SHT
#undef ALU
	ALU_NEG:
		DST = (u32) -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU64_NEG:
		DST = -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_X:
		DST = (u32) SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_K:
		DST = (u32) IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_X:
		DST = SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_K:
		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL_ARGS:
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

			goto out;

			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */

		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}

		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;

	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP

		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)

			break;

		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;

			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)

					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),

					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),

					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else

					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;

		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_B] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_B,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_H] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_H,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_W] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_W,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_DW] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_DW,
	};
#undef BPF_INSN_3_LBL
#undef BPF_INSN_2_LBL
	u32 tail_call_cnt = 0;

#define CONT	 ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })
#define CONT_JMP ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })

select_insn:
	goto *jumptable[insn->code];

	/* Explicitly mask the register-based shift amounts with 63 or 31
	 */
	/* ALU (shifts) */
		CONT;
	/* ALU (rest) */
		CONT;
	ALU(ADD,  +)
	ALU(SUB,  -)
	ALU(AND,  &)
	ALU(OR,   |)
	ALU(XOR,  ^)
	ALU(MUL,  *)
	SHT(LSH, <<)
	SHT(RSH, >>)
#undef SHT
#undef ALU
	ALU_NEG:
		DST = (u32) -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU64_NEG:
		DST = -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_X:
		DST = (u32) SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_K:
		DST = (u32) IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_X:
		DST = SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_K:
		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL_ARGS:
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL_ARGS:
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		CONT;

		CONT;

	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)

	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)

#endif

		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),

			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;

#undef BPF_INSN_2_LBL
	u32 tail_call_cnt = 0;

#define CONT	 ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })
#define CONT_JMP ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })

select_insn:
	goto *jumptable[insn->code];

	/* Explicitly mask the register-based shift amounts with 63 or 31
	 */
	/* ALU (shifts) */
		CONT;
	/* ALU (rest) */
		CONT;
	ALU(ADD,  +)
	ALU(SUB,  -)
	ALU(AND,  &)
	ALU(OR,   |)
	ALU(XOR,  ^)
	ALU(MUL,  *)
	SHT(LSH, <<)
	SHT(RSH, >>)
#undef SHT
#undef ALU
	ALU_NEG:
		DST = (u32) -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU64_NEG:
		DST = -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_X:
		DST = (u32) SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_K:
		DST = (u32) IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_X:
		DST = SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_K:
		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL_ARGS:
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,

			goto out;

			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}

		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)

		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)

			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)

		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here

		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;

		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_H] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_H,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_W] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_W,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_DW] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_DW,
	};
#undef BPF_INSN_3_LBL
#undef BPF_INSN_2_LBL
	u32 tail_call_cnt = 0;

#define CONT	 ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })
#define CONT_JMP ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })

select_insn:
	goto *jumptable[insn->code];

	/* Explicitly mask the register-based shift amounts with 63 or 31
	 */
	/* ALU (shifts) */
		CONT;
	/* ALU (rest) */
		CONT;
	ALU(ADD,  +)
	ALU(SUB,  -)
	ALU(AND,  &)
	ALU(OR,   |)
	ALU(XOR,  ^)
	ALU(MUL,  *)
	SHT(LSH, <<)
	SHT(RSH, >>)
#undef SHT
#undef ALU
	ALU_NEG:
		DST = (u32) -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU64_NEG:
		DST = -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_X:
		DST = (u32) SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_K:
		DST = (u32) IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_X:
		DST = SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_K:
		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL_ARGS:
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);

		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

static u64 ___bpf_prog_run(u64 *regs, const struct bpf_insn *insn)
{
#define BPF_INSN_2_LBL(x, y)    [BPF_##x | BPF_##y] = &&x##_##y
#define BPF_INSN_3_LBL(x, y, z) [BPF_##x | BPF_##y | BPF_##z] = &&x##_##y##_##z
	static const void * const jumptable[256] __annotate_jump_table = {
		[0 ... 255] = &&default_label,
		/* Now overwrite non-defaults ... */
		BPF_INSN_MAP(BPF_INSN_2_LBL, BPF_INSN_3_LBL),
		/* Non-UAPI available opcodes. */
		[BPF_JMP | BPF_CALL_ARGS] = &&JMP_CALL_ARGS,
		[BPF_JMP | BPF_TAIL_CALL] = &&JMP_TAIL_CALL,
		[BPF_ST  | BPF_NOSPEC] = &&ST_NOSPEC,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_B] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_B,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_H] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_H,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_W] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_W,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_DW] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_DW,
	};
#undef BPF_INSN_3_LBL
#undef BPF_INSN_2_LBL
	u32 tail_call_cnt = 0;

#define CONT	 ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })
#define CONT_JMP ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })

select_insn:
	goto *jumptable[insn->code];

	/* Explicitly mask the register-based shift amounts with 63 or 31
	 */
	/* ALU (shifts) */
		CONT;
	/* ALU (rest) */
		CONT;
	ALU(ADD,  +)
	ALU(SUB,  -)
	ALU(AND,  &)
	ALU(OR,   |)
	ALU(XOR,  ^)
	ALU(MUL,  *)
	SHT(LSH, <<)
	SHT(RSH, >>)
#undef SHT
#undef ALU
	ALU_NEG:
		DST = (u32) -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU64_NEG:
		DST = -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_X:
		DST = (u32) SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_K:
		DST = (u32) IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_X:
		DST = SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_K:
		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL_ARGS:
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;

		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,

		CONT;

		CONT;

		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

#define BPF_INSN_3_LBL(x, y, z) [BPF_##x | BPF_##y | BPF_##z] = &&x##_##y##_##z
	static const void * const jumptable[256] __annotate_jump_table = {
		[0 ... 255] = &&default_label,
		/* Now overwrite non-defaults ... */
		BPF_INSN_MAP(BPF_INSN_2_LBL, BPF_INSN_3_LBL),
		/* Non-UAPI available opcodes. */
		[BPF_JMP | BPF_CALL_ARGS] = &&JMP_CALL_ARGS,
		[BPF_JMP | BPF_TAIL_CALL] = &&JMP_TAIL_CALL,
		[BPF_ST  | BPF_NOSPEC] = &&ST_NOSPEC,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_B] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_B,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_H] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_H,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_W] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_W,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_DW] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_DW,
	};
#undef BPF_INSN_3_LBL
#undef BPF_INSN_2_LBL
	u32 tail_call_cnt = 0;

#define CONT	 ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })
#define CONT_JMP ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })

select_insn:
	goto *jumptable[insn->code];

	/* Explicitly mask the register-based shift amounts with 63 or 31
	 */
	/* ALU (shifts) */
		CONT;
	/* ALU (rest) */
		CONT;
	ALU(ADD,  +)
	ALU(SUB,  -)
	ALU(AND,  &)
	ALU(OR,   |)
	ALU(XOR,  ^)
	ALU(MUL,  *)
	SHT(LSH, <<)
	SHT(RSH, >>)
#undef SHT
#undef ALU
	ALU_NEG:
		DST = (u32) -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU64_NEG:
		DST = -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_X:
		DST = (u32) SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_K:
		DST = (u32) IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_X:
		DST = SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_K:
		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL_ARGS:
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

It processes BPF programs by handling various opcodes like arithmetic operations, memory access, jumps, and function calls. However, the only way it can invoke a function outside of its own scope (like `bpf_tcp_sock`) is through a BPF `call` instruction, which would use the `JMP_CALL` or `JMP_CALL_ARGS` labels in the jumptable.

The `JMP_CALL` and `JMP_CALL_ARGS` code paths in `___bpf_prog_run` execute function calls via a base function pointer (`__bpf_call_base` or `__bpf_call_base_args`) with an offset determined by the `imm` field of the BPF instruction. The available functions that can be called are limited to a fixed set of kernel functions that are pre-approved and registered in the BPF calling infrastructure.

`bpf_tcp_sock` is not a standard BPF helper function and is not part of the known set of functions registered via `__bpf_call_base`. Unless it is explicitly registered as a BPF helper and referenced by an instruction in a BPF program, it cannot be called from `___bpf_prog_run`.

Therefore, under normal execution, and without explicit registration and invocation via BPF instruction, it is not semantically or functionally reasonable to expect that `___bpf_prog_run` will reach `bpf_tcp_sock`.

		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

			goto out;

			goto out;

			goto out;

		 */

		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}

		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;

	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)

	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)

		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86

#endif

#undef LDST

			break;

		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		BPF_INSN_MAP(BPF_INSN_2_LBL, BPF_INSN_3_LBL),
		/* Non-UAPI available opcodes. */
		[BPF_JMP | BPF_CALL_ARGS] = &&JMP_CALL_ARGS,
		[BPF_JMP | BPF_TAIL_CALL] = &&JMP_TAIL_CALL,
		[BPF_ST  | BPF_NOSPEC] = &&ST_NOSPEC,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_B] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_B,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_H] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_H,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_W] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_W,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_DW] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_DW,
	};
#undef BPF_INSN_3_LBL
#undef BPF_INSN_2_LBL
	u32 tail_call_cnt = 0;

#define CONT	 ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })
#define CONT_JMP ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })

select_insn:
	goto *jumptable[insn->code];

	/* Explicitly mask the register-based shift amounts with 63 or 31
	 */
	/* ALU (shifts) */
		CONT;
	/* ALU (rest) */
		CONT;
	ALU(ADD,  +)
	ALU(SUB,  -)
	ALU(AND,  &)
	ALU(OR,   |)
	ALU(XOR,  ^)
	ALU(MUL,  *)
	SHT(LSH, <<)
	SHT(RSH, >>)
#undef SHT
#undef ALU
	ALU_NEG:
		DST = (u32) -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU64_NEG:
		DST = -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_X:
		DST = (u32) SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_K:
		DST = (u32) IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_X:
		DST = SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_K:
		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= (SRC & 63);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_X:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

	JMP_CALL_ARGS:
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		CONT;

		CONT;

		CONT;

		CONT;

		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:

		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;

		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:

		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;

			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;

			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;

			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */

		goto select_insn;

		CONT;

		CONT;

		CONT;

	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)

	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)

	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)

		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)

			break;

		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;

			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else

					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}

					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),

					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),

					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),

			goto default_label;
		}

		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;

		BPF_INSN_MAP(BPF_INSN_2_LBL, BPF_INSN_3_LBL),
		/* Non-UAPI available opcodes. */
		[BPF_JMP | BPF_CALL_ARGS] = &&JMP_CALL_ARGS,
		[BPF_JMP | BPF_TAIL_CALL] = &&JMP_TAIL_CALL,
		[BPF_ST  | BPF_NOSPEC] = &&ST_NOSPEC,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_B] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_B,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_H] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_H,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_W] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_W,
		[BPF_LDX | BPF_PROBE_MEM | BPF_DW] = &&LDX_PROBE_MEM_DW,
	};
#undef BPF_INSN_3_LBL
#undef BPF_INSN_2_LBL
	u32 tail_call_cnt = 0;

#define CONT	 ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })
#define CONT_JMP ({ insn++; goto select_insn; })

select_insn:
	goto *jumptable[insn->code];

	/* Explicitly mask the register-based shift amounts with 63 or 31
	 */
	/* ALU (shifts) */
		CONT;
	/* ALU (rest) */
		CONT;
	ALU(ADD,  +)
	ALU(SUB,  -)
	ALU(AND,  &)
	ALU(OR,   |)
	ALU(XOR,  ^)
	ALU(MUL,  *)
	SHT(LSH, <<)
	SHT(RSH, >>)
#undef SHT
#undef ALU
	ALU_NEG:
		DST = (u32) -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU64_NEG:
		DST = -DST;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_X:
		DST = (u32) SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOV_K:
		DST = (u32) IMM;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_X:
		DST = SRC;
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOV_K:
		DST = IMM;
		CONT;
	LD_IMM_DW:
		DST = (u64) (u32) insn[0].imm | ((u64) (u32) insn[1].imm) << 32;
		insn++;
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_X:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> (SRC & 31));
		CONT;
	ALU_ARSH_K:
		DST = (u64) (u32) (((s32) DST) >> IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_X:

		CONT;
	ALU64_ARSH_K:
		(*(s64 *) &DST) >>= IMM;
		CONT;

		div64_u64_rem(DST, SRC, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU64_MOD_K:
		div64_u64_rem(DST, IMM, &AX);
		DST = AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_MOD_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		DST = do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_X:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, SRC);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_X:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) SRC);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU64_DIV_K:
		DST = div64_u64(DST, IMM);
		CONT;
	ALU_DIV_K:
		AX = (u32) DST;
		do_div(AX, (u32) IMM);
		DST = (u32) AX;
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_BE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_be16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_be32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_be64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;
	ALU_END_TO_LE:
		switch (IMM) {
		case 16:
			DST = (__force u16) cpu_to_le16(DST);
			break;
		case 32:
			DST = (__force u32) cpu_to_le32(DST);
			break;
		case 64:
			DST = (__force u64) cpu_to_le64(DST);
			break;
		}
		CONT;

	/* CALL */
	JMP_CALL:
		/* Function call scratches BPF_R1-BPF_R5 registers,
		 */
		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2, BPF_R3,
						       BPF_R4, BPF_R5);
		CONT;

		BPF_R0 = (__bpf_call_base_args + insn->imm)(BPF_R1, BPF_R2,
							    BPF_R3, BPF_R4,
							    BPF_R5,
							    insn + insn->off + 1);
		CONT;

	JMP_TAIL_CALL: {
		struct bpf_map *map = (struct bpf_map *) (unsigned long) BPF_R2;
		struct bpf_array *array = container_of(map, struct bpf_array, map);
		struct bpf_prog *prog;
		u32 index = BPF_R3;

		if (unlikely(index >= array->map.max_entries))
			goto out;

		if (unlikely(tail_call_cnt >= MAX_TAIL_CALL_CNT))
			goto out;

		tail_call_cnt++;

		prog = READ_ONCE(array->ptrs[index]);
		if (!prog)
			goto out;

		/* ARG1 at this point is guaranteed to point to CTX from
		 */
		insn = prog->insnsi;
		goto select_insn;
out:
		CONT;
	}
	JMP_JA:
		insn += insn->off;
		CONT;
	JMP_EXIT:
		return BPF_R0;
	/* JMP */
		CONT;
	COND_JMP(u, JEQ, ==)
	COND_JMP(u, JNE, !=)
	COND_JMP(u, JGT, >)
	COND_JMP(u, JLT, <)
	COND_JMP(u, JGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(u, JLE, <=)
	COND_JMP(u, JSET, &)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGT, >)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLT, <)
	COND_JMP(s, JSGE, >=)
	COND_JMP(s, JSLE, <=)
#undef COND_JMP
	/* ST, STX and LDX*/
	ST_NOSPEC:
		/* Speculation barrier for mitigating Speculative Store Bypass.
		 */
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
		barrier_nospec();
#endif
		CONT;
		CONT;

	LDST(B,   u8)
	LDST(H,  u16)
	LDST(W,  u32)
	LDST(DW, u64)
#undef LDST

			break;

	STX_ATOMIC_DW:
	STX_ATOMIC_W:
		switch (IMM) {
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_ADD, add)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_AND, and)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_OR, or)
		ATOMIC_ALU_OP(BPF_XOR, xor)
#undef ATOMIC_ALU_OP

		case BPF_XCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				SRC = (u32) atomic_xchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) SRC);
			else
				SRC = (u64) atomic64_xchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) SRC);
			break;
		case BPF_CMPXCHG:
			if (BPF_SIZE(insn->code) == BPF_W)
				BPF_R0 = (u32) atomic_cmpxchg(
					(atomic_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u32) BPF_R0, (u32) SRC);
			else
				BPF_R0 = (u64) atomic64_cmpxchg(
					(atomic64_t *)(unsigned long) (DST + insn->off),
					(u64) BPF_R0, (u64) SRC);
			break;

		default:
			goto default_label;
		}
		CONT;

	default_label:
		/* If we ever reach this, we have a bug somewhere. Die hard here
		 */
		pr_warn("BPF interpreter: unknown opcode %02x (imm: 0x%x)\n",
			insn->code, insn->imm);
		BUG_ON(1);
		return 0;
}
